interface.signature: say_hello(name: list[str], city: str, state: str) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(name, list) and all(isinstance(part, str) for part in name) and len(name) >= 1
preconditions.description: name is a non-empty list of strings.

postconditions.description: The returned string concatenates 'Hello, ', the space-joined name parts, '! Welcome to ', the city, ', ', the state, and '!' in that exact order.
